name: Thief
summary: A burglar and treasure hunter with quick hands.

features.name: Fast Hands
features.short: Bonus action: Sleight of Hand, thieves' tools or Use an Object.
features.summary: You can use the bonus action granted by Cunning Action to make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check, use thieves' tools to disarm a trap or open a lock, or take the Use an Object action.

features.name: Second-Story Work
features.short: Climb at full speed; longer running jumps.
features.summary: Climbing costs you no extra movement, and your running jump distance increases by feet equal to your Dexterity modifier.

features.name: Supreme Sneak
features.short: Advantage on Stealth if you move at half speed.
features.summary: You have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks if you move no more than half your speed on that turn.

features.name: Use Magic Device
features.short: Ignore class, race and level requirements on magic items.
features.summary: You ignore all class, race and level requirements on the use of magic items.

features.name: Thief's Reflexes
features.short: Take two turns in the first round of combat.
features.summary: You can take two turns during the first round of any combat: your first at your normal initiative and your second at your initiative minus 10.
